question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The population _______ very fast in the last decade.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To correctly fill in the blank, we need to consider the tense and form of the verb that correctly matches the context provided by **"in the last decade**". This phrase indicates a time period that began in the past and continues to the present.
 
• The present perfect tense, which is formed using "has" + past participle, is appropriate for actions that occurred at** an unspecified time** before now and are relevant to the present.
 
• Option 3, "has risen", fits this structure perfectly.

Hence, the correct statement is ***'The population has risen__ very fast in the last decade'. ***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__***

 Other options are not in proper tense so can't be placed here. 

 
• Option 1 =** Incorrect, **It is in** past perfect tense and is also in passive voice**. So, it doesn't match the tense that the sentence requires.
 
• Option 2 =** Incorrect, **It is in** incorrect format. **The verb is in** V4** form without any helping verb here. So, it doesn't match the tense that the sentence requires.
 
• Option 3 = **Incorrect,** It is in** present indefinite tense. **So, it doesn't match the tense that the sentence requires.
